numinance.kinds.v1.AdapterBinding.jsonsc.description: AdapterBinding is one provider installation serving a port.

instance.description: instance is required: the configured instance of the provider (one provider may serve several, such as two CI servers).

provider.description: provider is required: the extension id of a provider of the port, which must resolve to a lockfile entry.

numinance.kinds.v1.AdapterBinding.jsonsc.title: Adapter Binding

numinance.kinds.v1.AdapterPorts.jsonsche.description:
AdapterPorts binds the ports that reach customer systems; a port added later is a new
 optional field. Each binding is replaced as a unit, never pairing one scope's provider with another's instance.

knowledge.description:
knowledge names the KnowledgeConnection objects the scope may read; a narrower scope's list replaces the wider one.
 Deprecated in 1.3.0: a knowledge source is an MCP-backed plugin named in AdapterSelectorSpec.tools (design sections 14 and 17).

numinance.kinds.v1.AdapterPorts.jsonsche.title: Adapter Ports

numinance.kinds.v1.AutonomyDefaults.json.description: AutonomyDefaults is the level used when no rule matches.
numinance.kinds.v1.AutonomyDefaults.json.title: Autonomy Defaults

numinance.kinds.v1.AutonomyFloor.jsonsch.description:
AutonomyFloor caps the level of the changes it matches; when floors from the org and control packs match, the
 lowest max_level holds.

match.description: match is required; the loader enforces it, the schema cannot.

max_level.description: max_level is required: no rule, default or narrower scope resolves a matching change above it.
max_level.title: Autonomy Level

numinance.kinds.v1.AutonomyFloor.jsonsch.title: Autonomy Floor

numinance.kinds.v1.AutonomyFloors.jsonsc.description: AutonomyFloors is the set of floors; it is one message so the whole set carries the FORBID directive.

rules.description: rules is required and non-empty; the loader enforces it, the schema cannot.

numinance.kinds.v1.AutonomyFloors.jsonsc.title: Autonomy Floors

numinance.kinds.v1.AutonomyMatch.jsonsch.description:
AutonomyMatch selects changes; an absent key matches every value and an empty match matches every change. In a
 rule, risk matches exactly and a key the change has no value for does not match. In a floor, risk matches that
 class and every higher one, and a key the change has no value for counts as a match.

environment.description: environment is the name of the environment the change acts in.

playbook.description: playbook is the name of the change's playbook.

risk.description: risk is the change's risk class, fixed at Classified.
risk.title: Risk Class

numinance.kinds.v1.AutonomyMatch.jsonsch.title: Autonomy Match

numinance.kinds.v1.AutonomyPolicySpec.js.description:
AutonomyPolicySpec resolves a level: the lowest level of the matching rules, else the default; then no level
 above the lowest max_level of the matching floors.

defaults.description:
defaults is the level when no rule matches; absent everywhere means PR for READ, LOW and MEDIUM risk and
 Suggest for HIGH and PRIVILEGED.

floors.description:
floors cap the level; only an org-scoped kind or a control pack may set them. Absent in the org means the shipped
 floor (Suggest for HIGH and PRIVILEGED, PR for the rest); only org floors displace it, pack floors only add caps.

rules.description:
rules set levels for the changes they match; a narrower scope's list replaces the wider one, and no rule of any
 scope resolves a change above any control pack's floors or the org's floors (else the shipped floor).

numinance.kinds.v1.AutonomyPolicySpec.js.title: Autonomy Policy Spec

numinance.kinds.v1.AutonomyRule.jsonsche.description: AutonomyRule sets the level of the changes it matches.

match.description: match is required; the loader enforces it, the schema cannot.

numinance.kinds.v1.AutonomyRule.jsonsche.title: Autonomy Rule

numinance.kinds.v1.BudgetPolicySpec.json.description: BudgetPolicySpec holds the limits; an absent field is unset and comes from a wider scope.

files_changed.description: files_changed is the maximum number of files changed.

lines_changed.description: lines_changed is the maximum number of lines changed.

max_risk_escalation.description: max_risk_escalation is the highest risk class a run may escalate to.
max_risk_escalation.title: Risk Class

network_destinations.description: network_destinations is the maximum number of distinct network destinations.

repositories.description: repositories is the maximum number of repositories touched.

retries.description: retries is the maximum number of retries.

services.description: services is the maximum number of services touched.

tokens.description: tokens is the maximum model spend in tokens.

tool_calls.description: tool_calls is the maximum number of tool calls.

wall_clock.description: wall_clock is the maximum elapsed time.

numinance.kinds.v1.BudgetPolicySpec.json.title: Budget Policy Spec

numinance.kinds.v1.Metadata.jsonschema.s.description: Metadata names a kind object and fixes its scope.

name.description: name is required and unique per kind and scope; other kinds reference the object by it.

scope.description: scope is required and not SCOPE_UNSPECIFIED; the loader enforces the latter.
scope.title: Scope

numinance.kinds.v1.Metadata.jsonschema.s.title: Metadata

numinance.kinds.v1.ResidencyFloors.jsons.description: ResidencyFloors is the set of floors; it is one message so the whole set carries the FORBID directive.

floor.description: floor is required: it applies to every change, together with every matching rule's floor.
floor.title: Residency Class

rules.description: rules add floors per component and environment; a rule never relaxes floor.

numinance.kinds.v1.ResidencyFloors.jsons.title: Residency Floors

numinance.kinds.v1.ResidencyMatch.jsonsc.description:
ResidencyMatch selects changes; an absent key matches every value and an empty match matches every change, and a
 key the change has no value for counts as a match. Floors from the org and control packs all hold together.

component.description:
component is the name of the component the change touches. It is not a security boundary until floors match only
 components of an org-owned SIGNED_POLICY registry, since a repo can rename one.

environment.description: environment is the name of the environment the change acts in.

numinance.kinds.v1.ResidencyMatch.jsonsc.title: Residency Match

cross_region.description: cross_region is true when inference may run in a region other than the source region; absent means false.

floors.description:
floors are the residency floors; only an org-scoped kind or a control pack may set them. Absent in the org means
 the floor IN_ACCOUNT, which pack floors add to and never displace; an org lowers it only by writing one.

regions.description:
regions is required and non-empty: the allowed source and destination regions, each one region name ("*" is
 refused). A list cannot carry FORBID, so the profile context refuses it below the org scope until tighten-only.

require_customer_keying.description: require_customer_keying is true when data at rest must be encrypted with customer-managed keys; absent means false.

retention_max.description: retention_max is the longest a model vendor may retain prompts and responses; absent means no retention.

training_use.description:
training_use says whether a model vendor may train on prompts and responses (ADR 0019). Absent means TRAINING_USE_FORBIDDEN; it is optional so that no document that omits it changes meaning. Setting TRAINING_USE_ALLOWED
 widens what is permitted, so like the other limits it carries FORBID and only the org sets it.
training_use.title: Training Use

numinance.kinds.v1.ResidencyPolicySpec.j.title: Residency Policy Spec

numinance.kinds.v1.ResidencyRule.jsonsch.description: ResidencyRule adds a floor for the changes it matches.

match.description: match is required; the loader enforces it, the schema cannot.

numinance.kinds.v1.ResidencyRule.jsonsch.title: Residency Rule

numinance.kinds.v1.SDLCProfile.jsonschem.description:
SDLCProfile binds a component to its stages, playbooks, control and architecture packs, toolchains, adapters,
 autonomy, residency and budgets. Other kinds are named; adapters, autonomy, residency and
 budgets are inline.

extensions.description: extensions holds vendor or customer data under reverse-DNS keys; the Engine never reads it.

metadata.description: metadata is required; the loader enforces it, the schema cannot.

spec.description: spec is required; the loader enforces it, the schema cannot.

numinance.kinds.v1.SDLCProfile.jsonschem.title: SDLC Profile

numinance.kinds.v1.SDLCProfileSpec.jsons.description:
SDLCProfileSpec holds the bindings; an absent field is unset and comes from a wider scope. A policy-bearing field has
 authority only when the profile is loaded from a protected path or a signed policy bundle; any other copy, even one
 claiming SCOPE_ORG, is RepositoryAuthored with no authority. The loader also
 refuses a FORBID field in a document whose metadata.scope is not SCOPE_ORG.

adapters.description:
adapters binds ports as AdapterSelector does; adapters.knowledge names the KnowledgeConnection objects the component
 may read.

architecture_packs.description: architecture_packs names the ArchitecturePack objects that apply, unique; a narrower scope adds names.

autonomy.description:
autonomy sets levels as AutonomyPolicy does, one more layer at the profile's scope after that scope's AutonomyPolicy;
 its floors carry FORBID, and no rule resolves a change above the org's and every pack's floors.

budgets.description:
budgets sets limits as BudgetPolicy does, in its units; only an org-scoped profile sets it until a tighten-only
 directive exists, since a narrower scope could otherwise raise a count or max_risk_escalation.

control_packs.description:
control_packs names the ControlPack objects that apply, unique; each name resolves only to a ControlPack. A narrower
 scope adds names, never removes one, so a repo cannot drop a pack the org applies.

playbooks.description: playbooks names the Playbook objects the component may run, unique; a narrower scope adds names, never removes one.

residency.description:
residency sets limits as ResidencyPolicy does; its floors and limits carry FORBID and its required regions are
 refused below the org scope, so only an org-scoped profile sets it.

stages.description:
stages names the StageRegistry the component follows; only an org-scoped profile sets it, so a narrower scope cannot
 select a registry without the org's gates.

toolchains.description: toolchains names the LanguageToolchain objects of the component, unique; a narrower scope adds names.

numinance.kinds.v1.SDLCProfileSpec.jsons.title: SDLC Profile Spec
